snippets.output: Chlorhexidine is an antiseptic and disinfectant used for skin disinfection before surgery, sterilizing surgical instruments, and various other medical and dental applications.
Chlorhexidine is effective against a range of microorganisms but does not inactivate spores.
Chlorhexidine is available in different formulations, including liquid and powder forms, and can be used to disinfect patients’ skin and healthcare providers’ hands.
Chlorhexidine has been used since the 1950s and has a broad spectrum of antiseptic activity.
Chlorhexidine is effective in preventing healthcare-associated infections (HAIs).
Chlorhexidine is used for skin cleansing and decolonization, preoperative showering and bathing, vascular catheter site preparation, and oral decontamination.
Chlorhexidine has a low risk of causing side effects, but it can cause skin irritation, teeth discoloration, and allergic reactions, with side effects similar to those of other topical antiseptics.
